bids.description:
Based in Dongguan, China—the heart of the country’s electronics manufacturing hub—I can help you uncover trending human gadgets, smart devices, electronics and lifestyle products while connecting them with reliable Chinese suppliers.

My sourcing experience covers supplier verification, business-license and company checks, capability comparisons, pricing and MOQ negotiation, samples, production requirements and lead times. I also work with technical hardware, PCBA solutions, custom USB devices and consumer electronics, making me well suited to assess innovative products beyond surface-level trends.

You will receive organized product information with available photos or videos, wholesale pricing, supplier and manufacturer contacts, MOQ details and shipping information. I can also help identify suppliers suitable for the Indian dropshipping market and reduce the risk of dealing with unreliable factories. Choose me for practical, China-based product research and sourcing backed by real supplier information.

Hello, I am from Shenzhen, China, and I am very interested in your company's procurement and order integration project. I have 15 years of experience in procurement and supply chain management, with a solid understanding of manufacturing processes in Chinese factories. I possess extensive capabilities in developing factory resources, including direct access to original manufacturers in electronics, hardware, and fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) sectors.

Hello,

I run a dropshipping business in India and need a freelancer currently living in mainland China to find trending, innovative, high-margin products.

Tasks:
- Research new products on 1688, Alibaba, Taobao, Pinduoduo and Douyin
- Send a weekly shortlist of 10-20 products with photos, links, supplier details, price, MOQ, sample cost and shipping time to India
- Contact suppliers in Chinese and confirm dropshipping support

Requirements: fluent Chinese, good English, sourcing or e-commerce experience.

In your bid, please share:
1. Your sourcing experience
2. 3 trending product ideas for India, with reasons
3. Your price per weekly list

A small paid trial comes first, then long-term work.
I'm in Guangzhou, China, familiar with Chinese business and markets, and can quickly find the most suitable products.

My 10+ years of China sourcing experience make me well suited to finding trending products and reliable low-MOQ suppliers for your dropshipping business in India. I source through Alibaba, 1688, Made-in-China, and direct factories, covering consumer goods, gadgets, electronics, lifestyle products, and other product categories.

I have completed sourcing projects for dropshipping products, solar products, cosmetics, plush toys, apparel, matcha, water filtration systems, and more. My experience includes product research, supplier verification, factory research, RFQs, quotation comparison, price negotiation, MOQ checks, and shipping coordination. I can provide product details, photos or videos, wholesale pricing, supplier contacts, MOQ, and shipping information for promising China-market products.

Choose me for focused China-based product sourcing backed by practical supplier and procurement experience. I am ready to help you identify quality products and profitable supplier opportunities for the Indian market.

source.description:
I'm looking for a freelancer currently living in China to help me find trending and innovative products for my dropshipping business in India.

Requirements:

Must be based in China.

Find trending human gadgets, smart gadgets, electronics and lifestyle products.

Discover unique and viral products from Chinese markets.

Find reliable manufacturers and suppliers with low MOQ.

Share product photos, videos, wholesale prices and supplier contact details.

Deliverables:

Product details and pricing.

Supplier/manufacturer contacts.

MOQ and shipping information.

Payment: $10–$20/30 or negotiable for quality leads.

Important: Only China-based freelancers should apply. Please share sample products you can find.
